battle.name: 魏伐百濟
battle.brief: 北魏太和十二年，孝文帝拓跋宏應百濟之請，遣平西將軍龔寶、征南將軍慕容彌將步騎五萬自齊州渡海，進攻百濟。魏軍登陸廣津，連破城邑三十餘座，進逼漢城，終因糧草不繼而退，遭高句麗與百濟追擊而大潰。卡面這把秦弩是攻城骨幹：弩手封住登城通道，強弩自巢車層臺居高壓制守軍，弩矢與糧草一齊耗盡。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 北魏一方是北魏太和十二年（488）西征的北魏軍，名義上出兵救援百濟，實際統率權落在平西將軍、營陽公龔寶與征南將軍、遼東公慕容彌兩位主將手上，步騎號稱五萬。兵源以鮮卑騎兵、平州與代州邊軍為骨幹，配以冀州、青州的漢人步卒，隨軍有輜重隊、工匠、醫工與通譯。齊州、青州一線設留守與糧臺，車騎由平城調發，馮太后在宮中坐鎮，宗室諸王在河南備宿。百濟一方守的是三都之地：以漢城為首都，熊津為陪都，毗曇為副都，國王居漢城，領地北面已失帶方、樂浪兩郡，東面受高句麗逼迫，軍隊以城壘與弓弩為主，長於守城而短於野戰。百濟求援先後找過劉宋，宋廷只作封賞與撫問而未出兵，魏兵卻先一步登岸。高句麗由文咨王高藏執政，遣兵沿漢江上游南下接應，在山峽要路上設阻援點，是迫使魏軍退走的最直接力量。南齊在建武年間與北魏通使，商議聯合夾擊百濟、牽制高句麗，雖未出兵配合，卻在外交上替魏軍鋪了路。
countriesEn: The Northern Wei side was the army raised for the western expedition of 488, formally dispatched to rescue Baekje, but with the real command in the hands of two generals: Gong Bao, General Who Pacifies the West and Duke of Yanyang, and Murong Mi, General Who Conquers the South and Duke of Liaodong. Their force was claimed at fifty thousand foot and horse. The core was Xianbei cavalry and the frontier garrisons of Pingzhou and Daizhou, supported by Han infantry from Jizhou and Qingzhou, accompanied by baggage trains, craftsmen, army surgeons and interpreters. A rear headquarters and supply depot were established on the Qingzhou–Jizhou line, draught animals and wagons came down from Pingcheng, Empress Dowager Feng held court in the capital, and members of the imperial clan stood ready to garrison Henan. The Baekje side defended its three capitals: Hanyang as the royal capital, Kumgang as the secondary capital and Pitan as the third, with the king residing at Hanyang. Its northern districts of Jikfang and Lelang had already been lost, the eastern frontier was pressed by Goguryeo, and its troops relied on fortifications and crossbows, strong in defence and weak in open battle. Baekje had first asked the Liu Song court for help and received only investiture and formal condolences, no troops, while Wei's soldiers landed first. Goguryeo was ruled by King Munja, and sent troops south along the upper Han River to link up, blocking the mountain passes and cutting the road — the direct force that turned the Wei army back. Southern Qi exchanged envoys with Northern Wei during the Jianwu era and discussed a joint attack on Baekje to pin down Goguryeo; although Qi sent no troops, its diplomacy paved the way for the Wei expedition.
people: 決定這場戰爭的是北魏孝文帝拓跋宏。他時年二十二歲，遷都洛陽與全面漢化尚在籌劃之中，馮太后仍在主持朝政，卻已在議事堂上拍板西征，一半算的是高句麗，一半算的是他自己新秩序的威信。真正主導戰術構想的兩個人：龔寶是平西將軍、營陽公，出身關中，久在河西與吐谷渾一帶周旋，熟悉持久戰與糧道經營；慕容彌是前燕宗室、慕容暐之弟，前燕亡後仕魏，賜爵遼東公，他曾奉命出使南朝，與齊人商議夾攻百濟，替魏爭取到一個外交上的牽制方向。慕容彌統南線，龔寶統西路，兩道兵馬在漢江下游一帶會合。百濟國王遣使北魏求援，許諾引導魏軍直趨高句麗腹地，並請魏廷派兵護送使者往返，以打通被高句麗截斷的南北通道。百濟世子與諸將分守三都，城防全仗弩手與城頭弓箭手。北方高句麗的文咨王高藏調兵接應，遣將沿山道下來切斷魏軍糧車，是全場最關鍵的敵手動作。魏廷內部反對者也不是沒有：朝中議者擔心遠征耗糧，擔心深入之後無援可恃，主張只遣使議和、倚賴齊國出兵。
peopleEn: The man who decided on this war was Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei, Tuoba Hong. He was only twenty-two years old; the move of the capital to Luoyang and the full-scale Sinicization were still being planned, and Empress Dowager Feng still presided over the court, yet the expedition to the east was approved in the council chamber, half for the sake of Goguryeo and half for the authority of his own new order. Two men shaped the operational plan. Gong Bao, General Who Pacifies the West and Duke of Yanyang, came from the Guanzhong region and had long campaigned in Hexi and against the Tuyuhun, and was well versed in protracted war and the management of supply lines. Murong Mi, General Who Conquers the South and Duke of Liaodong, was a member of the former Yan royal house, a brother of Murong Wei, who had entered Wei's service after Yan's fall; he had been sent on embassy to the southern court and had discussed with the Qi envoys a joint attack on Baekje, giving Wei a diplomatic lever for pinning down its enemy. Murong Mi took the southern route and Gong Bao the western one, and their columns met in the lower Han River region. The king of Baekje sent envoys north to Wei asking for help, promising to guide the Wei army straight into the heartland of Goguryeo and requesting escorts for envoys travelling in both directions so as to reopen the north-south route that Goguryeo had cut. The crown prince and the commanders of Baekje held the three capitals, and the defence of the walls rested entirely on crossbowmen and archers on the parapets. In the north, King Munja of Goguryeo moved troops to the rescue and sent officers down the mountain roads to cut Wei's baggage train — the single most decisive enemy action of the campaign. Nor were there no objectors in the Wei court: councillors at court worried about grain consumption on a distant expedition and about the army being unsupported once it went deep, and argued for sending only envoys to negotiate and leaning on Qi to carry the burden.
kits: 卡面這把秦弩是魏軍攻城序列裡的骨幹。弩機把拉開的弓弦拉力存住，弩手踩踏懸臂上弦，一扣扳機即出，射速遠勝拉弓；射程雖不及強弓射得遠，卻能在更遠的距離上保持準頭，是壓制城頭的骨幹火力。魏軍的弩並非單兵所持的輕弩，除單兵腰弩外還備有諸葛弩一類的守具與大型床弩，攻城時以巢車層臺為射臺，強弩自高處覆蓋城頭通道，步卒的雲梯、撞車則在弩火下推進。弩手按三段配置：前排蹲姿速射、中排立射壓制、後排裝填待補，壯士在後補矢，一具弩配矢數十支，攻城一日的矢支消耗是以萬計級別的負擔，這也是遠征軍最容易被拖垮的一項。魏軍另有排盾手持大盾附長槍，另有撞車、望樓、投石車與井車，沿著海岸還得自備運糧的船，車船隨軍即成為兵力的負擔。其餘裝備為人馬甲胄、長柄刀、環首刀與角弓。百濟、高句麗方面靠角弓與大盾，鎬則大量用陶製與鐵製，形制短而厚，適合近身城頭格鬥；高句麗的城防是曲尺形的土城，木柵、女牆、鹿角拒馬互相配合，弓弩手在城頭以連射壓制登城者，與魏軍的弩手形成完全相反的運用方向。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card is the backbone of Wei's siege order of battle. The trigger mechanism stores the strain of the drawn bowstring; the crossbowman stamps on the stirrup to cock it and releases with a single pull of the trigger, giving a rate of fire far above that of the bow. Its range is shorter than that of a powerful longbow, but it holds its accuracy at greater distance, and it is the principal fire support for suppressing defenders on the walls. The crossbows in Wei's hands were not merely the light weapons carried by individual soldiers: besides the single-man waist crossbow, the army had the strong crossbow of the Zhuge type and heavy bed crossbows for defence, and during a siege these were mounted on multi-storeyed siege towers as firing platforms, so that the heavy crossbows covered the approaches along the parapet while ladders and battering rams advanced under that crossbow fire. The crossbowmen were formed in three lines: the front line crouching and shooting fast, the middle line standing and delivering suppressing fire, the rear line cocking and waiting, with picked men behind them carrying fresh bolts. A crossbow was issued with several dozen bolts, and a single day of siege consumed bolts on a scale of thousands — a burden of its own, and the one most likely to cripple an expeditionary army. Wei also had shield-wall troops carrying large shields and long spears, along with battering rams, watchtowers, stone-throwers and well-scooping machines, and along the coast it had to bring its own grain ships, so that wagons and boats added to the burden of the marching force. The rest of its equipment consisted of armour for men and horses, long-handled sabres, ring-pommel swords and composite bows. Baekje and Goguryeo relied on composite bows and large shields, while their spearheads were largely ceramic or iron, short and thick in form and suited to close fighting on the walls. The Goguryeo fortification was a bent, square-shaped earthwork in which wooden palisades, parapets and deer-horn chevaux-de-frise reinforced one another, while bow and crossbowmen on the walls answered the assault with rapid volleys — the exact opposite use of the crossbow to Wei's.
tactics: 魏軍的作戰程序分四段。第一段集結：兵馬與輜重在齊州、濟南一線會合，先造船，再由萊州、登萊一帶下海。第二段渡海：冬季渤海海面風浪大，船隊分批北航，目標是百濟北岸的廣津一帶登陸。第三段攻堅：登陸後分兩路，一路由海岸北上趨熊津，一路由內陸直趨漢城；每下一城即設營、置柵、分兵守備，以免後路被斷，卻也步步分兵。攻城次第是先弩後梯：巢車層臺上的強弩先掃清城頭，壓制守軍的射界；排盾手舉大盾護住雲梯靠近牆根；撞車撞門；步卒攀梯登城，逐段爭奪牆頭。第四段補給：糧食、弩矢、矢材全部靠海路與陸路車隊後送，補給線一拉長便失去效率，攻得越深，送得越慢，這是全役最要緊的一環。撤退時若戰況不利，魏軍只能退回廣津一線的登船點，而高句麗的游騎已沿山道切斷糧隊，飢寒與疲憊在退路上放大，弩手大量脫隊，攻城器械被棄於道旁。
tacticsEn: The operation ran in four stages. First, concentration: troops and baggage assembled on the Jizhou–Jinan line, ships were built, and the force put to sea from the Laizhou and Denglai districts. Second, the crossing: the Bohai was rough in winter, the fleet sailed north in divisions, and the intended landing lay at the broad estuary (Gwangjin) on the northern coast of Baekje. Third, the assault: after landing the force split in two, one column moving north along the coast toward Kumgang, the other striking inland toward Hanyang; every city taken was garrisoned at once with a camp, a palisade and a detachment held back, so as not to have the line cut, but the army was also thinned step by step. The order of attack was crossbow first, ladder second: the heavy crossbows on the multi-storeyed siege towers first swept the parapet and killed the defenders' fields of fire; shield troops raised their large shields to cover the ladders against the wall; rams beat at the gates; and infantry climbed to take the wall section by section. Fourth, supply: grain, bolts and bow staves all had to follow by sea and by wagon train, and once the line of supply was stretched its efficiency collapsed — the deeper the army advanced, the slower the trains came, and this was the most critical link in the whole operation. When the situation turned, Wei could only fall back on the landing beaches at Gwangjin to re-embark, but Goguryeo's mounted skirmishers had already cut the baggage trains along the mountain roads, hunger and cold multiplied on the line of retreat, crossbowmen fell out of ranks in large numbers, and siege machines were abandoned along the road.
data: 兵力：一類史書繫此事於齊建武四年、北魏太和十二年十月，記北魏將步騎五萬；實際投入攻城的兵馬當然少於此數，但仍以萬計。戰果：連破百濟城邑三十餘座，最遠抵漢江下游，進逼漢城與熊津一線，這些城池後來全部復失。距離：齊州到廣津為渤海海航，尋常數百里；廣津到漢城，陸路二百餘里。時間：十月發兵，入冬之際已深入，翌年初退兵，前後數月。損失：通鑑一類記載寫魏軍退兵時為高句麗與百濟追擊，死者過半；也有寫法說十之七八，數目彼此矛盾，只能當作慘重的概括來看。百濟方面的損失是三十餘座城池被攻陷，以及一批守軍、弩手與器械被殲。弩的消耗沒有留下確數，但攻城型遠征的物資結構很清楚：糧盡與弩矢耗盡是同一條後勤線上的兩個死結。二十一年後，即497年，北魏再攻百濟，破四十餘城、深入至浿水一線，敗得更慘，可作對照。
dataEn: Strength: one class of historical record dates this affair to the tenth month of Jianwu 4, the twelfth month of Taihe 12, and states that Northern Wei mustered fifty thousand foot and horse. The number actually committed to the assault was of course lower, but still numbered in the thousands of men. Results: thirty-odd fortified places of Baekje were taken in succession, the farthest advance reaching the lower Han River and pressing toward Hanyang and the Kumgang line; all of these cities were subsequently retaken. Distances: from Jizhou to Gwangjin was a sea passage across the Bohai, several hundred li in normal conditions; from Gwangjin to Hanyang by land was a little over two hundred li. Duration: the army set out in the tenth month, was already deep inland as winter set in, and began withdrawing at the turn of the year, so the operation ran for several months. Losses: the Tongjian and works of its class record that during the withdrawal the Wei army was pursued by Goguryeo and Baekje and lost more than half its men; other versions give seven in ten or eight in ten. The figures contradict one another and can only be read as a rough summary of a severe loss. On the Baekje side the losses were the fall of more than thirty cities together with the destruction of garrisons, crossbowmen and weapons. No exact figure survives for the consumption of bolts, but the material structure of a distant siege is clear enough: empty granaries and exhausted bolt stocks were two dead ends on the same supply line. Twenty-one years later, in 497, Northern Wei attacked Baekje again, took more than forty cities and pushed down to the line of the Pyŏng River, and was destroyed more completely, which makes a useful comparison.
cause: 百濟求援的直接起因，是高句麗自五世紀中葉起步步緊逼。高句麗先取百濟北面的帶方郡，繼而又奪樂浪郡，把百濟的疆域向漢江下游擠壓；百濟失了北方兩郡，農兵與丁口大量淪陷，漢城與熊津之間的通道暴露在對方騎兵之下。百濟先向劉宋求援，宋廷只作封賞與空泛的撫問，並沒有出兵；轉而向同出於鮮卑的北魏求援，希望北魏在北方出兵牽制高句麗。北魏孝文帝正好需要這個藉口：魏在東北的飛地樂浪、帶方失守已久，恢復郡治、通過百濟直抵高句麗腹地，是把邊疆防線往南推的辦法；南方新喪國統的齊也想借百濟之手把北魏拖在東方，好讓自己騰出手經營北方。因此這一戰從頭到尾是三方各取所需：百濟要解圍，高句麗要保住新得的兩郡，魏要打通遼東通道，齊要在魏齊之間製造一個共同的敵人。
causeEn: The immediate occasion for Baekje's appeal was the steady tightening of Goguryeo's grip from the middle of the fifth century. Goguryeo first took the northern district of Jikfang from Baekje, then seized Lelang, squeezing Baekje's territory down toward the lower Han River. With the two northern districts lost, a large part of its peasantry and manpower fell to the enemy, and the corridor between Hanyang and Kumgang lay exposed to the enemy's horsemen. Baekje first asked Liu Song for help and got only investiture and vague words of comfort, with no troops sent; it then turned to Northern Wei, which came from the same Xianbei people, hoping that an expedition from the north would pin down Goguryeo. Emperor Xiaowen of Wei had precisely that use for the request: Wei had lost the outlying districts of Lelang and Jikfang in the northeast long since, and restoring them, opening a road through Baekje straight to the Goguryeo heartland, was a way of pushing the frontier defence line southward. Qi, which had just lost its ruling house, wanted in turn to pin Wei in the east so as to free its own hands for the north. The war was therefore, from beginning to end, a case of three parties each seeking something: Baekje wanted relief, Goguryeo wanted to keep the two districts it had taken, Wei wanted a corridor opened to Lelang, and Qi wanted a common enemy created between Wei and itself.
impact: 這一役沒有改變半島格局，卻改了北魏自身的戰略取向。兩次西征，488年與497年，都沒有打下漢城，第二次損折更重，把北魏的國力與軍心一起耗掉；此後魏廷放棄經略遼東，轉而把重心壓向南方，先遷洛陽，再改漢姓、推恩及於宗室，漢化改造的推進速度與南伐的籌劃幾乎同步。對高句麗而言，兩次擊退北方強權，等於贏得二十年的擴張期，向南整合百濟、向西兼併扶餘，盡量避免重蹈漢、晉兩代插手東北的覆轍；百濟則以殘存的三都體系繼續周旋，南方齊、魏兩家的遠交近攻成了它得以存活的唯一外交資本。武器技術面上，這一役也把弩的兩面性擺到檯面上：弩機能儲力、能連射，是攻城壓制城頭的骨幹火力，可弩矢的消耗與糧草消耗疊在一起，遠征一旦深入就會被自己的火力成本拖住，怎麼用弩、還要不要弩，成了後來圍城戰術必須回答的問題。
impactEn: The campaign changed no part of the peninsula's balance, yet it changed Northern Wei's own strategic orientation. Neither of the two expeditions, in 488 and in 497, took Hanyang, and the second was far more ruinous, draining the state's resources and the army's morale together. The Wei court afterwards abandoned the project of operating in Lelang and shifted its weight southward: first the move to Luoyang, then the adoption of Chinese surnames and the granting of imperial favour to members of the royal house, with the pace of Sinicization and the planning of the southern wars advancing almost in step. For Goguryeo, twice turning back a northern great power meant winning two decades of expansion, integrating Baekje to the south and absorbing Buyeo to the west, and avoiding as far as possible the fate of the Han and Jin dynasties, which had repeatedly meddled in the northeast. Baekje, for its part, continued to maneuver on the strength of its surviving system of three capitals, and the distant friendship and near antagonism of Qi and Wei became the only diplomatic capital that kept it alive. On the technical side of weapons, the campaign laid bare the two faces of the crossbow: its mechanism stores force and delivers rapid volleys, making it the backbone of fire support in assaults, but the consumption of bolts and the consumption of grain came in the same package, so that a deep expedition was dragged down by the very cost of its own firepower. How to use the crossbow, and whether to use it at all, became a question that later siege doctrine had to answer.
result: 結果是魏軍敗退。魏軍登陸廣津後節節攻破城邑，進逼漢城與熊津，卻始終沒有攻下都城；補給線拉得太長，糧食先行耗盡，弩矢與攻城器械也跟著告罄，軍心隨之鬆動。退兵之際，高句麗與百濟的追擊部隊在山道與海岸線上咬住魏軍後隊，魏軍一路丟棄器械輜重，士卒因飢寒與疲憊大量倒斃，返抵登船點時已不成建制，一說死者過半，一說十之七八，史無定論。慕容彌、龔寶等主將在役後相繼病故，魏廷把這次失敗記作西征受挫，沒有再提立即重兵東進的話。百濟保住了三都與主要城池，高句麗保住了新得的帶方與樂浪，進而在半島上坐大；齊、魏之間的反覆拉鋸則一直延續到五世紀末，兩國的正面對抗才是下一段歷史的主角。
resultEn: The result was that the Wei army was driven back. After landing at Gwangjin it took city after city and pressed toward Hanyang and Kumgang, but it never carried the capital. The line of supply was stretched too far, the grain ran out first, the bolts and siege machines followed, and the morale of the troops went with them. During the withdrawal the pursuing troops of Goguryeo and Baekje hung on the rear of the Wei column along the mountain roads and the coastal track, and the Wei army abandoned its machines and baggage as it went; men collapsed in large numbers from hunger, cold and exhaustion, and what reached the embarkation beaches was no longer an organized force. One account puts the dead at more than half, another at seven or eight in ten, and the historians cannot settle it. Murong Mi, Gong Bao and the other commanders fell ill and died shortly after the campaign; the Wei court entered the failure in its records as a repulse on the western expedition and spoke no more of immediately renewing the campaign with heavy forces. Baekje kept its three capitals and its principal cities; Goguryeo kept the districts of Jikfang and Lelang it had gained and grew strong on the peninsula; and the repeated maneuver between Qi and Wei ran on until the end of the fifth century, when the direct confrontation between the two states became the main business of the next chapter of history.
